newsitem.title: DENMARK: Two dead, 15 hurt in Danish biker war blast.
newsitem.headline: Two dead, 15 hurt in Danish biker war blast.

text.p: Two people died and at least 15 were injured when a shoulder-fired anti-tank missile blasted a Hell's Angels biker gang party in the Danish capital early on Sunday, police said.
The attack appeared to be the latest in a three-year "turf war" between two Nordic biker gangs.
Copenhagen police murder squad chief Kurt Jensen told Reuters at the scene that there were two dead and at least 15 injured "that we know of".
He said the party at the central Copenhagen clubhouse was attended by visiting Hell's Angels from other countries.
"It was quite a big gathering," Jensen said. "The partygoers were very shocked. We are still trying to assess the extent of the damage."

Police said the weapon used was a Swedish-designed Carl Gustav shoulder-fired missile unleashed from a yard across the street from the clubhouse. They were searching the homes in Copenhagen of several members of the rival Bandidos biker gang with whom the Hell's Angels have been battling.
